'''Nara Safalla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. She was stationed in [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun's]] [[CI-004 Research Facility]]<ref name="Op" /> in [[3627 BBY]].
